## Checklist

- [ ] `python -m pytest`, `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass
- [ ] `npm test` passes in `web/` (and in `demo/` if `web/` or `demo/` changed)
- [ ] Tests added or updated; security-sensitive changes have tests
- [ ] `docs/API.md`, `.env.example` / README configuration table and the demo (`demo/src/`) updated if the HTTP contract or settings changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under "Unreleased" for user-visible changes
